A1.justification: Local reading tools stalled without returning document content, preventing inspection of either PDF or its appendices. The supplied filenames identify a version pair, but identity and material completeness could not be verified. This is an access gap, not evidence of missing or deleted content.

before.justification: No content from v2.pdf was available for inspection, so original empirical results could not be verified.

after.justification: No content from v3.pdf was available for inspection, so original empirical results could not be verified.

M1.justification: The method descriptions were unavailable, preventing comparison of algorithms, models, objectives, and inference procedures.

E1.justification: Dataset and task descriptions were unavailable, preventing verification of retained, added, or removed experimental coverage.

E2.justification: The reported comparisons were unavailable, so comparator membership could not be checked across corresponding experiments.

E3.justification: Experimental protocols were unavailable, preventing comparison of splits, metrics, budgets, preprocessing, and testing procedures.

E4.justification: Neither the main-text nor appendix analyses could be inspected, preventing assessment of changes to ablations, robustness tests, and case studies.

E5.justification: Run counts, seed information, and statistical reporting could not be inspected in either version.

E6.justification: Results tables, figures, and passages were unavailable, preventing verification of numerical or qualitative changes under matched conditions.

T1.justification: Definitions, assumptions, derivations, and proofs could not be inspected or matched across versions.

C1.justification: The abstracts, introductions, and conclusions were unavailable, preventing comparison of core claims and contributions.

C2.justification: Interpretations, mechanism explanations, applicability boundaries, and limitations could not be inspected.

D1.justification: Technical and reproducibility disclosures were unavailable, preventing comparison of implementation details and resource-access information.

R1.justification: Related-work passages and references were unavailable, preventing verification of citation and research-positioning changes.

P1.justification: Document text and section structure could not be inspected, so the extent of editing or reorganization is unresolved.

P2.justification: Rendered pages, figures, and tables were unavailable, preventing assessment of visual presentation and layout changes.

improvement.justification: Neither PDF could be inspected because local reading tools remained unresponsive. Without before-and-after evidence, the benefits, harms, and overall quality implications of the revision cannot be assessed.
